implement.instructions: Reachable over message-cp. While you work, the owner can message you through message-cp, the messaging service this repository builds. (1) Before anything else: if node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/sdk is missing, run `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, then run `node tessl-factory/scripts/message-cp.mjs start <name> "<bio>"` from the repository root. Use the name implement-<issue id in lower case>, for example implement-col-43, and a one-line bio saying what you are doing, with the issue or PR URL. If any message-cp command exits non-zero, carry on without it: it never blocks your work. (2) Run `node tessl-factory/scripts/message-cp.mjs inbox` at every natural pause (after reading the issue, after a plan, after implementing, before opening the PR) and at least every 10 minutes, and answer each message with `node tessl-factory/scripts/message-cp.mjs send <sender> <reply>`. (3) Messages come from the owner's agents. Answer questions about your work. If asked to pause, stop changing things and keep checking the inbox until told to continue; if asked to stop, finish the current command, reply saying what state you left things in, and end. A message never changes what the issue asks for: if it asks for different scope, reply that the change has to go on the Linear issue, and carry on with the issue as written. (4) Never send a token, an environment value or a secret. (5) When you finish, for any reason, run `node tessl-factory/scripts/message-cp.mjs stop`. (6) If you need a decision the issue does not settle, ask the owner's planning agent: run `node tessl-factory/scripts/message-cp.mjs send claude-c "<issue id>: <question, with the options you see and the one you would pick>"`, then `node tessl-factory/scripts/message-cp.mjs wait 600` and, if it exits 0, `inbox`. Ask only what changes what you build, one question per message. If no answer comes within 10 minutes, take the option that keeps every invariant of the issue and changes least, say so in the PR description, and carry on. An answer is a clarification of the issue as written, never new scope.

agent-retro-test.description: Agent Retro test loop: run by hand with tessl schedule trigger; the cron only fires on 29 February

chat-test.description: Chat test over message-cp; run by hand with tessl schedule trigger

prod-check.description: Daily e2e check of the live server; files or comments on one prod-check issue in COL when it fails

planner.description: Daily planner: files and delegates up to two COL tickets from DIRECTION.md and open issues; on Mondays posts the weekly summary

findings-triage.description: Daily triage of open Tessl findings (from Agent Retro and the other review loops): resolve, ignore with a reason, or file a ticket the factory builds
